exposure: robotic-assisted approach for vesicouterine and vesicovaginal fistula repair
outcome: no de novo voiding or incontinence symptoms
cohort: A 31-year-old female presented with constant urinary leakage following a vaginal birth after prior cesarean section and was diagnosed with a complex branching vesicouterine and vesicovaginal fistula.
finding: A robotic approach to complex branching vesicouterine and vesicovaginal fistula is technically feasible and resulted in successful fistula resolution.
